title: Postgres 18.7, 17.12, and 16.16 now available
body: Lakebase updated its supported Postgres versions to [18.7](https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/18.7/), [17.12](https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/17.12/), and [16.16](https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/16.16/), less than 30 minutes after the [PostgreSQL community released them](https://www.postgresql.org/about/news/postgresql-187-1712-1616-1520-1425-and-19-rc-2-released-3442/). These minor releases include the latest upstream Postgres bug fixes and security patches. Lakebase applies a new minor version the next time your compute restarts. See [Recent minor version rollouts](/aws/en/oltp/projects/postgres-version-support#rollouts).
